items.q: What is a CDR for Engineers Australia?
items.a: A Competency Demonstration Report (CDR) is the portfolio Engineers Australia uses to assess engineers who do not hold an accredited qualification. It contains a Continuing Professional Development list, three career episodes and a summary statement.

items.q: What does CDR Writers Australia do?
items.a: We offer three core services: CDR Writing for a fresh report, CDR Review for an existing or self-written report, and CDR Optimization to fix errors, edit and improve it.

items.q: Is the CDR written from my own experience?
items.a: Yes. Every report is built from your own projects, duties and achievements. You review and understand the final content before you submit it.

items.q: Can you help after the CDR is written?
items.a: Yes. We also provide complete documentation, CDR submission support, visa consultation, migration guides and career advice.

items.q: Do you support assessments outside Australia?
items.a: Yes, through our sister companies. We cover authorities such as IPENZ in New Zealand, ECSA in South Africa, RICS in the United Kingdom and several Canadian engineering regulators.

items.q: Can you guarantee a positive outcome?
items.a: No. Assessment decisions are made by the relevant authority, so we cannot guarantee an outcome. We focus on a clear, accurate and complete report.
